name: MgIdentifier
label: MG identifier
description: A unique identifier for MG series of images. (NCIT:C69219)

name: SeriesInstanceIdentifier
label: Series instance identifier
description: A unique identifier for series of images. (NCIT:C69219)

name: BelongsToImagingStudy
label: Belongs to imaging study
description: Parent study context. (NCIT:C164493)

name: ImagesCount
label: Images count
description: The total number of discrete image instances, slices, or frames contained within this imaging series. (NCIT:C164540)

name: ImagingModality
label: Imaging modality
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy. (NCIT:C17369)

name: SeriesDate
label: Series date
description: The date on which a series began. (NCIT:C68616)

name: BodyRegion
label: Body region
description: The specific anatomical region, body part, or organ targeted by this imaging series. (NCIT:C12680)

name: Laterality
label: Laterality
description: The side of the body or paired organ being examined (e.g. Left, Right, Bilateral, Unilateral). (NCIT:C25185)

name: ImagingDevice
label: Imaging device
description: A device for producing a representation or picture, usually of a part of the body, to aid in diagnosis and evaluation. (NCIT:C19747)

name: ManufacturerOfImagingDevice
label: Manufacturer of imaging device
description: A person, enterprise, or entity that produces imaging device. (NCIT:C25392)

name: SoftwareVersion
label: Software version
description: A form or variant of software; one of a sequence of copies of a software program, each incorporating new modifications. (NCIT:C111093)

name: ColorSpace
label: Color space
description: The photometric interpretation of pixel data that defines the type of colour or greyscale encoding used in the image (e.g., MONOCHROME2, RGB, YBR_FULL). Corresponds to DICOM tag (0028,0004). (NCIT:C37927)

name: PixelSpacing
label: Pixel spacing
description: Physical distance between the centres of adjacent pixels in the image space, specified as row and column spacing. Expressed in millimetres (mm) according to DICOM attribute (0028,0030). (NCIT:C45786)

name: ImageType
label: Image type
description: A classification of the image based on the imaging modality and acquisition characteristics. It specifies the type of image produced during the scan (e.g., T1-weighted MRI, T2-weighted MRI, CT attenuation image, PET uptake image). (NCIT:C69268)

name: FileFormat
label: File format
description: The digital format used to encode and store an imaging file. (MS:1001459)

name: FileSize
label: File size
description: The size of the file in MB. (NCIT:C171192)

name: ImageWidth
label: Image width
description: Number of pixels in one row of the image, corresponding to the DICOM attribute Columns (0028,0011). (AFO:0002468)

name: ImageHeight
label: Image height
description: Number of pixels in one column of the image, corresponding to the DICOM attribute Rows (0028,0010). (AFO:0002467)

name: ImageDepth
label: Image depth
description: The number of distinct image planes captured during acquisition. For WSI, this represents the number of focal planes (Z-stack levels). For CT, MRI, and PET, it corresponds to the number of cross-sectional slices or frames. For DX and MG, this value is typically 1 (a single 2D projection). (NCIT:C69267)

name: NumberOfChannels
label: Number of channels
description: The number of distinct data channels stored in each pixel of the image. Channels may represent color components (e.g., RGB), grayscale intensity, or modality-specific signal dimensions. (REPRODUCEME:SamplesPerPixel)

name: ChannelResolution
label: Channel resolution
description: The number of bits used to represent the stored value of each pixel channel. In DICOM, this corresponds to tag (0028,0101). (REPRODUCEME:SignificantBits)

name: CompressionMethod
label: Compression method
description: Indicates whether the image was lossy-compressed and which method was used, based on DICOM tags (0028,2110) and (0028,2114). (NCIT:C64347)

name: AnnotationsAvailable
label: Annotations available
description: Indicates whether annotation data associated with the image (e.g., regions of interest, labels, markup, or segmentation overlays) are present and accessible. (NCIT:C44272)
